annotations.title: Hodge lead-lag decomposition of one network's metrics (paid)

description: Paid: 10 credits ($10) per answered call, charged once and only after a non-empty answer is computed; an unavailable answer, a refusal or an error costs nothing. Send your API key in the X-API-Key header or as api_key. Each call is a new answer and a new charge (no idempotency key). For one DePIN network: daily closes of its measured first-party metrics over the last `days` complete UTC days, each metric's daily log change, and the lag-1 lead-lag flow between every pair (correlation of one metric today with the other yesterday, minus the reverse). A Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition on the complete graph splits the flow into a gradient part (one consistent ordering, reported as a lead score per metric) and a curl part (cyclic lead-lag); the harmonic part is zero on a complete graph and is shown as a check. Descriptive, no significance test; the flow size expected under independence is given for scale. Uses up to `max_metrics` (3-16, default 10) metrics, by name order. Every input daily close is returned with its as_of and verify_url. The tool name is historical: no regime classification or trading signal is produced.

api_key.description: Your API key, only if your client cannot send the X-API-Key header.

days.description: Daily changes in the window (default 30), ending at the latest complete UTC day.

metric_filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of metric names, e.g. GPU.

symbol.description: One network ticker, e.g. AKT, FIL, RENDER.
